build_hyperlinear_layer: build a HyperLinear layer that uses a hypernetwork to generate time-dependent linear transformation weights and biases
create_concatlinear_layer: create a ConcatLinear layer that concatenates time scalar with input before applying a linear transformation
build_squashconv2d_layer: build a SquashConv2d convolutional layer that applies time-dependent gating via sigmoid to modulate output channels
create_gatedlinear_layer: create a GatedLinear layer that applies element-wise gating by multiplying output with a sigmoid-gated parallel linear projection
build_blendconv2d_layer: build a BlendConv2d layer that linearly interpolates between two parallel convolutions using a time scalar t
